An '''Informer''' was a rank obtained by [[Imperial Agent]]s under the employ of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Ministry of Intelligence]]. Informers often worked undercover within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and fed sensitive information back to their superiors. [[Ula Vii]] was an informer working in the offices of [[Supreme Commander]] [[Stantorrs]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
